instructions: Whether you're hosting a backyard barbecue or grilling on the beach, the sizzling sounds and mouth-watering aromas of food cooking on the grill promise a flame-broiled feast without the fuss. From succulent steaks and savory kabobs to finger-lickin' ribs and impressive roasts, Taste of Home's Backyard Grilling features 330 sensational selections for great outdoor entertaining or everyday dining. You'll even find innovative ideas for hot-off-the-grill appetizers and desserts to suit your tastes, along with great grilling tips, informative sidebars and a host of helpful hints
"A Taste of home/Reader's digest book"--Title page verso
